common_reading_error: Choosing a later useful action instead of the earliest required step
audit_question: What must occur before every other plausible option?
role_boundary_check: Does the option stay within current training and authorization?
revision_move: Make the two nearest options explicitly sequential

common_reading_error: Selecting the most comprehensive plan rather than the current response
audit_question: Which option addresses the present moment without skipping a prerequisite?
role_boundary_check: Does the option assume authority not stated in the stem?
revision_move: Remove background details that do not affect immediacy

common_reading_error: Treating initially as a synonym for eventually
audit_question: Which action starts the sequence?
role_boundary_check: Would this action normally require clarification or supervision first?
revision_move: Use one clear starting condition

common_reading_error: Preferring a detailed later procedure over an opening check
audit_question: What information or condition must be established at the outset?
role_boundary_check: Is the option an observation or communication step rather than an independent plan change?
revision_move: Separate opening checks from later implementation

common_reading_error: Reacting to urgency while ignoring role boundaries
audit_question: Which response is both timely and role-appropriate?
role_boundary_check: Does urgency change who is authorized to decide?
revision_move: State the urgency cue without implying unlimited authority

common_reading_error: Continuing the workflow while planning to correct the issue later
audit_question: What must be resolved before the workflow continues?
role_boundary_check: Is supervision or clarification required by the stated facts?
revision_move: Name the blocked next step

common_reading_error: Choosing any later action that sounds useful
audit_question: What is the single step immediately after the stated event?
role_boundary_check: Does the option add a new procedure that was never authorized?
revision_move: Anchor the stem to one completed prior step

common_reading_error: Ignoring the event that the word then refers back to
audit_question: What has already happened and what logically follows it?
role_boundary_check: Does the proposed follow-up remain inside the described role?
revision_move: Place the reference event in the sentence immediately before then

common_reading_error: Confusing a follow-up with a simultaneous action
audit_question: Which option depends on completion of the named event?
role_boundary_check: Is the action based on documented facts rather than inference?
revision_move: Clarify whether actions are sequential or concurrent

common_reading_error: Selecting the correct principle at the wrong point in time
audit_question: What prerequisite makes this later action appropriate?
role_boundary_check: Would the person need additional direction before acting?
revision_move: Include the prerequisite in the stem

common_reading_error: Re-performing the completed step instead of moving forward
audit_question: Which choices duplicate work already described as complete?
role_boundary_check: Does the next step require reporting or documentation within policy?
revision_move: Mark completed actions as complete only once

common_reading_error: Treating an unverified assumption as confirmed
audit_question: What exact fact has been confirmed and what does it permit?
role_boundary_check: Who is authorized to make or confirm that determination?
revision_move: Identify the source of confirmation

common_reading_error: Reversing two individually reasonable actions
audit_question: Which option must precede the other?
role_boundary_check: Does the earlier option preserve appropriate supervision and scope?
revision_move: Present the two actions as a deliberate near-neighbour pair

common_reading_error: Acting before the condition named by the stem is met
audit_question: Which choice is premature until the stated condition occurs?
role_boundary_check: Is the condition verified by an authorized source?
revision_move: State the condition in observable terms

common_reading_error: Treating a temporary boundary as a permanent prohibition
audit_question: What action is paused and what event ends the pause?
role_boundary_check: Does the option invent permission that has not been given?
revision_move: Name both the pause and the release condition

common_reading_error: Doing nothing when a limited role-safe action remains possible
audit_question: What can be done without crossing the pending decision boundary?
role_boundary_check: Which options require authorization that is still pending?
revision_move: Distinguish safe preparation from implementation

common_reading_error: Overlooking a prerequisite because the later action is more familiar
audit_question: What prerequisite is explicitly signaled?
role_boundary_check: Is the prerequisite a check communication or documentation step?
revision_move: Move the prerequisite close to the requested action

common_reading_error: Treating the restriction as optional advice
audit_question: Which option violates the only-after condition?
role_boundary_check: Who supplies the required approval or information?
revision_move: Make the restriction testable

common_reading_error: Choosing the most detailed option instead of the option that fits all facts
audit_question: Which option satisfies every controlling detail with the fewest assumptions?
role_boundary_check: Does any option require acting beyond the described role?
revision_move: Remove extra detail that rewards verbosity

common_reading_error: Selecting a generally correct statement that misses the scenario
audit_question: Which fact makes one plausible choice fit better?
role_boundary_check: Does the chosen response respect training authorization and supervision?
revision_move: Include one decisive scenario fact

common_reading_error: Preferring familiar wording over precise wording
audit_question: Which option can be supported directly by the information given?
role_boundary_check: Does the option claim more certainty than the evidence allows?
revision_move: Make the precision difference intentional

common_reading_error: Choosing a true but secondary reason
audit_question: Which reason directly controls the decision?
role_boundary_check: Does the reason rely on an unstated policy or authority?
revision_move: Separate primary from supporting reasons

common_reading_error: Listing several benefits instead of identifying the central purpose
audit_question: Which option remains true if secondary benefits are removed?
role_boundary_check: Is the stated purpose consistent with the authorized role?
revision_move: Delete incidental benefits from distractors

common_reading_error: Forgetting that the stem asks for the exception or weakest fit
audit_question: Which option fails a requirement that the others satisfy?
role_boundary_check: Does the rejected option cross a role or evidence boundary?
revision_move: Visually emphasize the negative qualifier

common_reading_error: Importing facts from a similar remembered example
audit_question: Which claims are supported by the current stem only?
role_boundary_check: Does the option require a decision by someone not present in the facts?
revision_move: Remove cues that invite outside assumptions

common_reading_error: Treating limited data as proof of a broad conclusion
audit_question: What is the narrowest defensible conclusion?
role_boundary_check: Is escalation or supervision more appropriate than independent interpretation?
revision_move: State what the data do and do not show

common_reading_error: Replacing observation with interpretation
audit_question: Which option describes what was directly observed?
role_boundary_check: Does the response distinguish recording from clinical interpretation?
revision_move: Use observable fictional details

common_reading_error: Relying on memory when the stem specifies a record
audit_question: What does the documented source actually establish?
role_boundary_check: Is the option asking the learner to alter or merely consult the record?
revision_move: Identify the document without including confidential data

common_reading_error: Filling gaps with a preferred explanation
audit_question: Which option adds the fewest unsupported assumptions?
role_boundary_check: Should the next step be clarification rather than invention?
revision_move: Make the missing information intentional

common_reading_error: Substituting personal preference for the stated source
audit_question: Which choice aligns with the written source as described?
role_boundary_check: Does any change require supervisor direction?
revision_move: Keep the fictional plan description general

common_reading_error: Choosing a plausible action that belongs to another role
audit_question: Which option can be completed without exceeding the stated role?
role_boundary_check: Does the action require assessment design diagnosis or independent plan revision?
revision_move: Contrast implementation with independent modification

common_reading_error: Treating earlier training as permission for an unstated change
audit_question: What direction was provided and what remains outside it?
role_boundary_check: Does the option extend beyond the supervisor's described instruction?
revision_move: Specify the scope of the fictional direction

common_reading_error: Guessing because one answer resembles prior practice
audit_question: Which option obtains appropriate clarification?
role_boundary_check: Can the uncertainty be resolved without independent clinical judgment?
revision_move: State the uncertainty instead of hiding it

common_reading_error: Attempting the task because it seems simple
audit_question: Which option preserves safety and scope while seeking support?
role_boundary_check: Does the choice acknowledge the training boundary?
revision_move: Remove wording that rewards overconfidence

common_reading_error: Selecting convenience over privacy limits
audit_question: Which option uses only the minimum authorized information?
role_boundary_check: Is disclosure limited to the appropriate person and purpose?
revision_move: Use fictional non-identifying details only

common_reading_error: Silently correcting or ignoring an inconsistency
audit_question: Which option documents or clarifies the discrepancy without inventing a fix?
role_boundary_check: Who is authorized to resolve the discrepancy?
revision_move: State the inconsistency without implying its cause
